epics.title: Lists that sort
epics.detail: A made-up release of a made-up list app, here to show how a board reads.

stories.title: Wider tap targets on a phone
stories.detail: Every button in a row is at least 44 points tall, so a thumb lands on the right one.
notes: Measured on the smallest phone the app supports.

slices.title: Raise the row height
slices.detail:
Goal: a row is at least 44 points tall.
Files: src/row.css.
Done when: the row test measures 44 points or more.

slices.title: Space the buttons in a row
slices.detail:
Goal: 8 points between a row's buttons.
Files: src/row.css.
Done when: no two buttons in a row touch at phone width.

stories.title: Sortable column headers
stories.detail: Click a column's header to sort the list by it, and click again to turn the order around.
notes: Numbers sort as numbers, not as text.

slices.title: A sort helper for text and numbers
slices.detail:
Goal: one function that sorts rows by a column, text by the alphabet and numbers by value.
Files: src/sort.js, src/sort.test.js.
Done when: the tests pass for text, numbers, and empty cells.

slices.title: Header buttons with an arrow
slices.detail:
Goal: each header is a button, and the sorted one shows an arrow for its order.
Files: src/Header.vue.
Done when: a click sorts, a second click turns the order around, and the arrow follows.

slices.title: Remember the last sort
slices.detail:
Goal: the list opens sorted the way it was left.
Files: src/sort.js, src/settings.js.
Done when: the sort is still there after the app restarts.

slices.title: Sort from the keyboard
slices.detail:
Goal: Enter and Space on a focused header sort by it.
Files: src/Header.vue.
Done when: the keyboard test sorts with both keys.

stories.title: An empty state for the list
stories.detail: A list with no rows says so, and offers the button that adds the first one.

stories.title: The date filter skips the last day
stories.detail: Filtering from the 1st to the 30th leaves out rows dated the 30th.
notes: Seen with every range: the end day is always missing.

slices.title: Make the end day count
slices.detail:
Goal: the filter keeps rows dated on the end day.
Files: src/filter.js, src/filter.test.js.
Done when: a test with a row on the end day passes.

slices.title: Say the range in the filter's label
slices.detail:
Goal: the label reads "from the 1st through the 30th".
Files: src/Filter.vue.
Done when: the label names both days.
notes: The wording needs a decision first.

stories.title: Print a list
stories.detail: A list prints on one page per 40 rows, with its title at the top of each page.

slices.title: A print layout for the list
slices.detail:
Goal: the list prints 40 rows to a page.
Files: src/print.css.
Done when: a list of 41 rows prints on two pages.

slices.title: The title on every page
slices.detail:
Goal: each printed page starts with the list's title.
Files: src/print.css, src/List.vue.
Done when: both pages of a two-page list show the title.

stories.title: Save a list as a file
stories.detail: A list saves as a CSV file that a spreadsheet opens.
